concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: art-direction concept sheet for an original browser tactical turn-based game, not a screenshot of implemented gameplay. Create a polished wide 3:2 illustrated concept board mixing customizable medieval fantasy armies with expressive cartoon card-game terrain. Rich hand-inked silhouettes, painterly gouache fills, warm parchment, moss greens, ochres, teal and burnt red faction cloth; charming expressive weathered faces, chunky readable equipment, not generic shiny mobile game rendering, not pixel art. Upper two thirds: a shallow side-view grassy battlefield at an old stone bridge, broken watchtower, rolling hills, expressive crooked trees, distinct grass/rock/marsh terrain patches, two small medieval formations facing each other, room to breathe, troops feel like characters in a story. Lower third: six large original full-body character explorations evenly spaced on parchment: sword and buckler militia with oversized helmet, hooded longbow ranger, broad tower-shield guardian, elderly herbalist medic with satchel and crystal staff, stocky bearded hammer veteran, lanky pikeman with scarf. Each has unique proportions and silhouette. Make no UI controls, no stats, no logos, no lettering, no branded characters. The illustration should feel like a deliberate cohesive game art direction, lively but with tactical readability.

assets.prompt: Use the attached image only as an art-style reference. Create a NEW game asset: one wide 3:2 panoramic EMPTY medieval fantasy battlefield background, gouache painted and inked in the same charming expressive storybook style. Old crooked watchtower and small stone bridge in upper half, rolling green hills, warm yellow autumn trees on outer edges, water meandering beside the bridge, distant pale castle. Foreground lower 60 percent is mostly unobstructed flattened grass and earth with subtle grass tufts and a few small stones, a broad arena where UI troop sprites will be placed. Camera shallow side-view, only slight top-down angle, horizon upper third. Friendly readable restrained color palette moss/ochre/teal, enough color and personality, medium contrast. No characters, soldiers, creatures, weapons, banners, text, logos, panels, UI, tiles, cards, grids or frame. No concept-sheet lower section. Full bleed single continuous scene.

Use attached image only as design and style reference. Produce a NEW game sprite atlas, a single transparent PNG, exactly a 3 column by 2 row equal-cell grid. Canvas landscape 3:2, each of the six cells perfectly square of identical size. Six complete medieval fantasy character sprites, one per cell, centered horizontally, boots at 90% of cell height, full silhouette within middle 80% cell width and 82% height including weapon, generous transparent padding, no sprite crosses cell boundaries. Top row left to right: sword and round buckler young militia with oversized helmet; lean hooded longbow ranger; very broad armored tower-shield guardian. Bottom row left to right: elderly herbalist medic with crystal staff and satchel; stocky bearded hammer veteran with heavy hammer; lanky pikeman with a SHORT enough spear held close vertically to fit cell. All standing in 3/4 side view facing RIGHT ready to fight, same scale for normal human height except stocky hammer veteran. Exaggerated distinctive silhouettes and expressive faces, chunky readable equipment, dark confident ink contours, painterly gouache flat shading, original polished illustrated fantasy game art. Outfit colors neutral warm brown, muted olive and warm steel; avoid saturated faction colors, faction badges are added in UI. Use the six character concepts from the bottom of the reference as inspiration, simplify detail to read at 100px. IMPORTANT entire background truly transparent alpha, no parchment, no terrain, no cards, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no frames, no panels, no floating items or additional figures. Exactly six sprites in equal 3x2 cells.
